description: Source file defining the implementation of the TextToSpeech plugin, including method registration, access control, configuration handling, and speech control functions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: TextToSpeech
classes.description: Implementation class for the TextToSpeech plugin, managing registration, configuration, playback control, access control, and API versioning.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all plugin methods with the framework.

methods.name: AddToAccessList
methods.description: Adds or updates a method and application pair in the access control list.

methods.name: HasAccess
methods.description: Checks if a given application has access to invoke a specified method.

methods.name: SetACL
methods.description: Sets access control list entries based on provided parameters.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the TTS functionality based on parameters.

methods.name: ListVoices
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available voices for a specified language.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the current TTS configuration settings.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Updates the TTS configuration with provided parameters.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Speaks the provided text with specified call sign.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels ongoing speech identified by speech ID.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses ongoing speech identified by speech ID.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes paused speech identified by speech ID.

methods.name: IsSpeaking
methods.description: Checks if the TTS engine is currently speaking for a given speech ID.

methods.name: GetSpeechState
methods.description: Retrieves the current speech state for a given speech ID.
